If you just updated your iPhone to iOS 27 and noticed the battery draining faster than usual, and the device getting warm under normal use, you may be concerned.

If this happens, don't panic. Although these two phenomena do exist, they are only temporary...

Every time you update your system to a new version of iOS, the system will continuously run some tasks in the background, which is particularly noticeable after a major update.

These background processes that consume a lot of CPU resources often cause your iPhone to run hotter than usual and consume significantly more battery. Apple has specifically issued a reminder on this.

The impact of iOS 27 is greater than before because the system needs to completely rebuild the device index to accommodate Siri AI, a process that may last for several days.

The good news is that once all background processing programs are completed, the device will return to normal. In fact, the efficient operation of iOS 27 means that after the update completes all underlying processes, you may find that battery life has improved.
